# Ezekiel 22 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-the-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying:

**2** "And-you, son-of man, will-you-judge, will-you-judge the-city-of blood? Then-make-known to-her all her-abominations.

**3** And-say, 'Thus says the-Lord YHWH: O-city shedding blood in-her-midst, [so that] her-time has-come, and-making idols against-herself to-become-unclean!

**4** In-your-blood which you-shed you-have-become-guilty, and-in-your-idols which you-made you-have-become-unclean, and-you-have-brought-near your-days, and-you-have-come to your-years; therefore I-have-made-you a-reproach to-the-nations and-a-mockery to-all the-lands.

**5** The-near and-the-far from-you shall-mock you — defiled-of name, great-of turmoil.

**6** Behold, the-princes-of Israel, each according-to his-strength, were in-you to-shed blood.

**7** Father and-mother they-treated-with-contempt in-you; the-sojourner they-oppressed in-your-midst; the-orphan and-the-widow they-wronged in-you.

**8** You-have-despised My-holy-things and-profaned My-Sabbaths; slanderers were in-you to-shed blood, and-upon-the-mountains they-ate in-you; lewdness they-committed in-your-midst.

**9** You-have-despised My-holy-things and-profaned My-Sabbaths; slanderers were in-you to-shed blood, and-upon-the-mountains they-ate in-you; lewdness they-committed in-your-midst.

**10** You-have-despised My-holy-things and-profaned My-Sabbaths; slanderers were in-you to-shed blood, and-upon-the-mountains they-ate in-you; lewdness they-committed in-your-midst.

**11** You-have-despised My-holy-things and-profaned My-Sabbaths; slanderers were in-you to-shed blood, and-upon-the-mountains they-ate in-you; lewdness they-committed in-your-midst.

**12** Bribery they-took in-you to-shed blood; interest and-increase you-took, and-you-extorted your-neighbor by-violence; and-Me you-forgot," declares the-Lord YHWH.

**13** You-have-despised My-holy-things and-profaned My-Sabbaths; slanderers were in-you to-shed blood, and-upon-the-mountains they-ate in-you; lewdness they-committed in-your-midst.

**14** You-have-despised My-holy-things and-profaned My-Sabbaths; slanderers were in-you to-shed blood, and-upon-the-mountains they-ate in-you; lewdness they-committed in-your-midst.

**15** You-have-despised My-holy-things and-profaned My-Sabbaths; slanderers were in-you to-shed blood, and-upon-the-mountains they-ate in-you; lewdness they-committed in-your-midst.

**16** You-have-despised My-holy-things and-profaned My-Sabbaths; slanderers were in-you to-shed blood, and-upon-the-mountains they-ate in-you; lewdness they-committed in-your-midst.

**17** You-have-despised My-holy-things and-profaned My-Sabbaths; slanderers were in-you to-shed blood, and-upon-the-mountains they-ate in-you; lewdness they-committed in-your-midst.

**18** "Son-of man, the-house-of Israel has-become to-Me dross; all-of-them [are] bronze and-tin and-iron and-lead in-the-midst-of a-furnace — dross-of silver they-have-become.

**19** You-have-despised My-holy-things and-profaned My-Sabbaths; slanderers were in-you to-shed blood, and-upon-the-mountains they-ate in-you; lewdness they-committed in-your-midst.

**20** You-have-despised My-holy-things and-profaned My-Sabbaths; slanderers were in-you to-shed blood, and-upon-the-mountains they-ate in-you; lewdness they-committed in-your-midst.

**21** You-have-despised My-holy-things and-profaned My-Sabbaths; slanderers were in-you to-shed blood, and-upon-the-mountains they-ate in-you; lewdness they-committed in-your-midst.

**22** You-have-despised My-holy-things and-profaned My-Sabbaths; slanderers were in-you to-shed blood, and-upon-the-mountains they-ate in-you; lewdness they-committed in-your-midst.

**23** And-the-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying:

**24** You-have-despised My-holy-things and-profaned My-Sabbaths; slanderers were in-you to-shed blood, and-upon-the-mountains they-ate in-you; lewdness they-committed in-your-midst.

**25** A-conspiracy-of her-prophets [is] in-her-midst, like-a-lion roaring, tearing prey; souls they-devour, wealth and-precious-things they-take; her-widows they-multiply in-her-midst.

**26** Her-priests have-violated My-law and-profaned My-holy-things; between the-holy and-the-common they-have-not-distinguished, and-between the-unclean and-the-clean they-have-not-made-known; and-from-My-Sabbaths they-hid their-eyes, and-I-am-profaned in-their-midst.

**27** Her-princes in-her-midst [are] like-wolves tearing prey — shedding blood, destroying souls, to-gain unjust-gain.

**28** And-her-prophets plastered for-them [with]-whitewash, seeing vanity and-divining lies for-them, saying, 'Thus says the-Lord YHWH,' when-YHWH has-not-spoken.

**29** The-people-of the-land have-practiced extortion and-committed robbery; and-the-poor and-the-needy they-have-oppressed, and-the-sojourner they-have-extorted without-justice.

**30** And-I-sought from-among-them a-man [who would]-build-up a-wall and-stand in-the-breach before-Me on-behalf-of the-land, so-that I-would-not-destroy-it; but-I-found-none.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **22:18**: Sigim — 'dross.' The smelting-furnace metaphor: Israel was supposed to be refined silver but has become the waste product. The furnace of judgment separates nothing valuable — all is dross.

- **22:26**: Bein qodesh le-chol lo hivdilu — 'between holy and common they did not distinguish.' The priests' failure is categorical: they collapsed the sacred/profane distinction that structured Israelite life.

- **22:30**: Va-avaqesh mehem ish — 'and I sought from among them a man.' YHWH's search for an intercessor yields nothing. The absence of even one righteous mediator seals Jerusalem's fate.

— EMET
